senses: adj. 固定不变的；模式化的
a.（法令、陈述）严格的，严厉的
a.（竞争、对立）严峻的，严酷的
a.（人或态度）严厉的；认真的
stern.usage: 记：本身为词根，意为“严格的”；[近]strict/severe a.严厉的；同义: harsh, serious, strict, severe；发音类似"死瞪"→有些严厉的老师可能会在课上死死地瞪着你，观察你的表现→严厉的；索引p417

ex.en: Her mother appeared, looking very stern.
ex.zh: 她母亲露面了，看上去非常严厉。

ex.en: The school took stern measures to deal with cheating in examinations.
ex.zh: 学校采取严厉措施应对考试作弊行为。

ex.en: Despite the stern warnings, some companies continued to release polluted water into the river.
ex.zh: 尽管警告严厉，一些公司仍继续向河里排放污水。

senses: n. (飞机、火车或轮船上的)乘务员，服务员
n. (大学等的)伙食管理员；(私人家的)管家
②粘住，粘贴；③(尤指迅速或随手)放置

ex.en: Whichever approach, the key is to determine your length of focus time and stick to it.
ex.zh: 不论是采取哪种办法，关键在于判定你能集中注意力的时间，并且坚持下去。

ex.en: A walking stick is useful on long mountain hikes.
ex.zh: 长途登山时手杖很有用。

ex.en: Despite the criticism, the committee stuck to its original plan.
ex.zh: 尽管遭到批评，委员会仍坚持原定计划。

senses: a. 硬的；僵硬的；生硬的
stiff.usage: 辨析:stiff坚硬不易弯曲,引申人太拘谨冷漠;rigid高度坚硬不能弯曲,也指固执己见；索引p417

ex.en: After sitting at the desk all day, his neck felt stiff.
ex.zh: 在书桌前坐了一整天，他的脖子发僵。

ex.en: The competition for the scholarship is stiff this year.
ex.zh: 今年奖学金的竞争非常激烈。

ex.en: She greeted us with a stiff smile and refused to chat.
ex.zh: 她以生硬的微笑迎接我们，不肯多聊。

senses: a. 静止的；平静的；寂静的

stimulate.usage: spur 的近义词；adj.饶有趣味的；增加活力的；发音类似“死题目late”→做这道死难的题目到很晚（late），需要鼓励刺激我，继续加油→刺激；鼓舞。；索引p417

ex.en: Likewise, automation should eventually boost productivity, stimulate demand by driving down prices, and free workers from hard, boring work. But in the medium term, middle-class workers may need a lot of help adjusting.
ex.zh: 同样，自动化最终也会促进生产力的提高，通过降低物价来刺激需求，并将工人从繁重枯燥的工作中解脱出来。但是在发展中期，中产阶级的工人可能还需要很多外界帮助来适应这种变化。

ex.en: The article can be used to stimulate discussion among students.
ex.zh: 这篇文章可用来激发学生的讨论。

ex.en: Negative attitudes toward obesity, grounded in health concerns, have stimulated a number of anti-obesity policies.
ex.zh: 人们对肥胖的消极态度基于对健康的关心，这也激发了一系列防止肥胖的政策。

stimulus.usage: n.刺激物,促进因素；刺激；索引p417

ex.en: The government introduced a stimulus package to support the struggling economy.
ex.zh: 政府推出了一揽子经济刺激计划，以支持陷入困境的经济。

ex.en: Light is an important stimulus for plant growth.
ex.zh: 光是植物生长的重要刺激因素。

ex.en: The tax cuts provided a much-needed stimulus to consumer spending.
ex.zh: 减税为消费者支出提供了急需的刺激。

senses: n. 刺,螫,叮；灼痛；刺伤力,刺激性
v. 叮，蜇；刺伤；激怒，使不安
sting.usage: 助记:音"死叮"；发音类似死盯→蜜蜂死盯你，肯定就想蜇你→蜇

ex.en: I was stung on the arm by a wasp.
ex.zh: 我的胳膊被黄蜂蜇了一下。

ex.en: The smoke stung my eyes as I entered the burning building.
ex.zh: 冲进着火的大楼时，烟熏得我眼睛刺痛。

ex.en: The harsh words left a sting that lasted for years.
ex.zh: 那些刻薄的话留下了多年不消的刺痛。

ex.en: Stir the sauce gently to keep it from burning.
ex.zh: 慢慢搅拌酱汁，以免烧糊。

ex.en: The scandal stirred public anger against the banking industry.
ex.zh: 这桩丑闻激起了公众对银行业的愤怒。

ex.en: The news caused quite a stir in the small town.
ex.zh: 这个消息在小城里引起了不小的轰动。

senses: n. 原料,备料;库存,存货
stock.usage: 串词记忆：家里常备(stock)牛排(steak)；索引p417

ex.en: The likelihood of being named in a federal class-action lawsuit also increases, and the stock is likely to perform worse.
ex.zh: 公司在联邦集体诉讼中被点名的可能性也在增加，公司股票的表现可能会更糟。

ex.en: The supermarket keeps a large stock of bottled water in summer, when demand rises sharply.
ex.zh: 这家超市在夏季储备了大量瓶装水，因为那时需求会急剧上升。

ex.en: Investors who bought the stock early became wealthy when the company went public.
ex.zh: 早在公司上市前就买入该股票的投资者发了财。

senses: vi. 屈尊,屈从;自贬,堕落
stoop.usage: 助记:她stop(停下来)stoop(弯腰)去捡东西

storage.usage: n.储存，贮藏；存储；n.储存，贮藏；（信息的）存 储

ex.en: But a boost in the storage capacity of batteries is making their ability to keep power flowing around the clock more likely.
ex.zh: 但是，电池存储容量的提升正使其更有可能能够昼夜不停地持续供电。

ex.en: The old warehouse was converted into a storage space for local farmers.
ex.zh: 那座旧仓库被改造成了当地农民的储藏空间。

ex.en: Cloud storage allows users to get their files from any device.
ex.zh: 云存储让用户可以在任何设备上获取自己的文件。

store.usage: n.商店；仓库；储备 v.储藏；储存；department store 百货商店

ex.en: Farmers store the grain in dry places to keep it from going bad.
ex.zh: 农民把谷物储存在干燥的地方以防变质。

ex.en: The new department store has attracted a large number of shoppers.
ex.zh: 这家新开的百货商店吸引了大量顾客。

ex.en: Camels store fat in their humps to survive long journeys in the desert.
ex.zh: 骆驼把脂肪储存在驼峰里，以便在沙漠长途跋涉中生存。

senses: n. 仓库；(信息或知识等的)宝库
n. 风暴,暴风雨,暴风雪
v. 暴怒,大发雷霆;猛攻,直捣
storm.usage: 词组take...by storm突袭攻占某处;使神魂颠倒

senses: v. 跨坐;跨越;横跨;对……持观望态度
a. 直的；正中目标的；坦诚的
a. 直截了当的；简单的
straightforward.usage: adj.简单的，易懂的；诚实的， 坦率的

ex.en: The instructions are straightforward enough for beginners to follow.
ex.zh: 这些说明简单明了，初学者也能照着做。

ex.en: She gave a straightforward answer without any excuses.
ex.zh: 她直截了当地作了回答，没有任何借口。

ex.en: Installing the software is a straightforward process that takes only a few minutes.
ex.zh: 安装这款软件的过程很简单，只需几分钟。

strain.usage: strain 指过度用力造成的压力/损伤；stress 含心理紧张与强调两义；strain（拉紧；压力）vs stain（污点）；n.压力；损伤 v.拉伤，扭伤；用力推(或拉)， 拉紧；索引p417

ex.en: I found it a strain having to concentrate for so long.
ex.zh: 我觉得这么长时间全神贯注挺累的。

ex.en: repeated strain imposed by oversized limbs
ex.zh: 因四肢过大所带来的持续重压

ex.en: strain natural resources
ex.zh: 过度使用自然资源

senses: n. (观点、计划、故事等的)部分,方面
a. 奇怪的；奇特的；陌生的

phrases.m: 觉得不舒服;觉得头昏眼花

strange.usage: 词组be strange to sth.对……生疏,对……不内行；adj.奇怪的；陌生的；令人难受 的

ex.en: It seems strange that no one noticed the error for months.
ex.zh: 奇怪的是，好几个月都没人发现这个错误。

ex.en: She felt strange walking through the empty streets of the unfamiliar city.
ex.zh: 走在这座陌生城市空荡荡的街道上，她感到不自在。

ex.en: There is nothing strange about higher prices during the holiday season.
ex.zh: 假日期间物价上涨没有什么奇怪的。

senses: adv. 离奇地,奇怪地,不寻常地
n. 陌生人；外地人；新来者
n. [sing.] 掐脖子；卡脖子；压制

strap.usage: 她用带子(strap)做了一个小陷阱(trap)

ex.en: The bag comes with detachable straps.
ex.zh: 这种包有可拆卸的带子。

ex.en: He strapped the suitcase to the roof of the car.
ex.zh: 他把手提箱捆在车顶上。

ex.en: The safety strap kept the climber from falling.
ex.zh: 安全带使登山者没有坠落。

ex.en: The bridge is of great strategic importance to the whole region.
ex.zh: 这座桥对整个地区具有重大战略意义。

ex.en: The company made a strategic decision to exit the retail market.
ex.zh: 公司作出了退出零售市场的战略决定。

ex.en: Both sides regard the port as a strategic target.
ex.zh: 双方都把这个港口视为战略目标。

senses: n. 策略；计策；行动计划；战略；战略部署
strategy.usage: n.策略，行动计划；战略；st(联想street街道)+rat(老鼠)+egy→对付街上的老鼠需要"策略"；索引p417

ex.en: We need to devise an effective long-term strategy.
ex.zh: 我们需要设计一个有效的长期战略。

ex.en: The airline's pricing strategy of filling empty seats at the last minute has squeezed its profits.
ex.zh: 这家航空公司在最后一刻以低价填满空座的定价策略挤压了自身的利润。

ex.en: A good learning strategy combines regular review with plenty of sleep, not endless all-night study.
ex.zh: 好的学习策略将定期复习与充足睡眠相结合，而不是无休止地熬夜苦读。

phrases.m: (一系列重压、打击下)终于使人不能忍受的最后一击

senses: n. 流浪宠物;走失的宠物

stream.usage: 辨析:series系列,指相互之间有一定关系的事物组成整体;bunch串,束;swarm(昆虫的)群,多指蜂群；n.小河，小溪 v.流动

ex.en: We followed a narrow stream up the mountain.
ex.zh: 我们沿着一条小溪上山。

ex.en: Complaints came in a steady stream after the price increase.
ex.zh: 涨价之后，投诉源源不断。

ex.en: Tears streamed down her face as she said goodbye.
ex.zh: 道别时，泪水从她脸上流下来。

senses: v. 使(某物)成流线型,使(某物)效率更高;作用更大
n. 力量，力气；实力，活力，效力

phrases.p: the relative strength of the English language

ex.en: The most immediate changes will be observed in skill level, strength and inches lost.
ex.zh: 最直接的变化将体现在技能水平、身体力量和腰围缩减方面。

ex.en: It took great strength for him to admit his mistake in public.
ex.zh: 当众承认错误需要他拿出极大的精神力量。

ex.en: The strength of the economy depends largely on consumer confidence.
ex.zh: 经济的实力在很大程度上取决于消费者信心。

strengthen.usage: reinforce 的近义词；v.巩固，加强；strength（力量）+en（动词后缀，使）→使有力量→加强；索引p417

ex.en: It will help strengthen their emotional bonds.
ex.zh: 这将有助于加强他们的情感纽带。

ex.en: Justices wanted to strengthen its coordination with Congress.
ex.zh: 法官们希望加强与国会的协调工作。

ex.en: The government plans to strengthen ties with neighbouring countries through new trade agreements.
ex.zh: 政府计划通过新的贸易协定加强与周边国家的关系。

senses: adj. ①努力的，奋力的；顽强的；紧张的
n. 精神压力；心理压力；紧张
stress.usage: st(=string 拉紧)+ress→拉紧的状态→压力；[近] emphasize, strain；族：stressful a. 压力重的。近义：pressure n. 压力；emphasis n. 强调；辨析：stress指精神压力、心理负担；pressure指为达目标的心理压力或单位面积压力；tension指外来

ex.en: People are actually more stressed at home than at work.
ex.zh: 人们在家中实际上比在工作中的压力更大。

ex.en: Because representative government presupposes an informed citizenry, the report supports full literacy; stresses the study of history and government, particularly American history and American government; and encourages the use of new digital technologies.
ex.zh: 这一代议制的政府预设其国民都受过良好的教育，因此该报告支持全面普及读写教育，强调对历史和政府的研究，特别是对美国历史和美国政府的研究，同时鼓励新的数字技术的应用。

ex.en: The manager stressed the importance of meeting the deadline.
ex.zh: 经理强调了按期完成任务的重要性。

senses: a. 极度焦虑不安的；心力交瘁的

ex.en: Moving to a new city can be a stressful experience for children.
ex.zh: 搬到新城市对孩子们来说可能是一段充满压力的经历。

ex.en: Doctors say long working hours make nursing one of the most stressful jobs.
ex.zh: 医生说，长时间工作使护理成为压力最大的职业之一。

ex.en: Regular exercise helps people cope with stressful situations.
ex.zh: 经常锻炼有助于人们应对紧张状况。

stretch.usage: 近义：extend v. 延伸，伸展；发音类似“死拽扯”→他“伸出”手臂拼命地拽我扯我→伸展；拉长。；串词记忆:伸出(stretch)双手抓住(catch)；索引p417

ex.en: The exercises are designed to stretch and tone your leg muscles.
ex.zh: 这些活动目的在于伸展和增强你的腿部肌肉。

ex.en: At the same time, listening through earphones to the same monotonous beats for long stretches encourages kids to stay inside their bubble instead of pursuing other endeavors.
ex.zh: 与此同时，长时间戴着耳机听一些一成不变的节奏会让孩子沉浸在自己的世界里而不愿努力去做其他事情。

ex.en: The desert stretches for hundreds of miles with barely any vegetation.
ex.zh: 这片沙漠绵延数百英里，几乎没有什么植被。

senses: a. 严厉的；严格的；恪守教规（或信条等）的
adj. (with)严格的,严厉的;严谨的,精确的
strict.usage: 族：strictly ad. 严格地。近义：rigid a. 严格死板的；adj.严格的，严厉的；索引p417

ex.en: We need to look beyond strict definitions of legal and illegal.
ex.zh: 我们需要超越合法和非法这种严格的定义(来思考这种划分)。

ex.en: The school is very strict about students using mobile phones in class.
ex.zh: 这所学校对学生上课使用手机的要求非常严格。

ex.en: Under the strict rules of the program, participants must report their progress every week.
ex.zh: 按照该项目的严格规定，参加者必须每周汇报进展。

senses: adv. 严格地,严谨地,严密地;绝对地,确实
strictly.usage: strict 的派生词；adv.严格地；完全地；仅限于

ex.en: The regulation applies strictly to imported goods.
ex.zh: 该法规严格适用于进口商品。

ex.en: Visitors are strictly forbidden from taking photographs inside the gallery.
ex.zh: 严格禁止参观者在美术馆内拍照。

ex.en: Strictly speaking, the answer depends on how the term is defined.
ex.zh: 严格说来，答案取决于这个术语如何定义。

senses: v. (strove,stridden) 阔步前进,大踏步走
n. 大步；一步（的距离）；进展
stride.usage: 同义: step, pace, walk；联想成“strive奋斗”→年轻人怎么奋斗呢？不要怕，大步向前走→大步走。

ex.en: He crossed the room in two strides.
ex.zh: 他两大步跨到屋子另一头。

ex.en: The company has made great strides in reducing its carbon emissions.
ex.zh: 该公司在减少碳排放方面取得了长足进步。

ex.en: She strode confidently into the boardroom and began her presentation.
ex.zh: 她自信地大步走进董事会会议室，开始作陈述。

senses: v. (struck,struck 或 stricken) 打击,撞,撞击

phrases.m: 击中要害;取得意想的结果

strike.usage: strike out 划掉;搞出,做成；词组还有 strike up sth. (with sb.) （和某人）开始来往；索引p417

ex.en: Now utopia has grown unfashionable, as we have gained a deeper appreciation of the range of threats facing us.
ex.zh: 如今，随着我们对自身面临的一系列威胁有了更加深刻的认识，乌托邦逐渐变得不再流行了。

ex.en: Thousands of nurses voted to strike after talks over pay collapsed for the third time.
ex.zh: 有关薪酬的谈判第三次破裂后，数千名护士投票决定罢工。

ex.en: It struck me that the two studies, though independent, had reached almost identical conclusions.
ex.zh: 我突然意识到，这两项研究虽然是独立进行的，却得出了几乎相同的结论。

senses: a. 显著的；惹人注目的
adj. 显著的,突出的;妩媚动人的,标致的
adj. 显著的，引人注目的
adj. 引人注目的；妩媚动人的
striking.usage: strike(打，击)+ing→锣鼓队敲敲打打的很"引人注目"；派生strikingly adv.；索引p417

ex.en: The similarities between the two cases are striking.
ex.zh: 这两个案例之间的相似之处是惊人的。

ex.en: The most striking feature of the building is its glass roof.
ex.zh: 这座建筑最引人注目的特征是它的玻璃屋顶。

ex.en: There is a striking contrast between the wealth of the city and the poverty of its outskirts.
ex.zh: 城市的富裕与郊区的贫困形成了鲜明对比。

senses: adv. 显著地，引人注目地
strikingly.usage: adv.显著地，突出地，引人注 目地；索引p417

ex.en: Her latest novel is strikingly different from her earlier work.
ex.zh: 她最新的小说与她早期的作品截然不同。

ex.en: The two paintings are strikingly similar, though they were created centuries apart.
ex.zh: 这两幅画惊人地相似，尽管创作时间相隔数个世纪。

ex.en: Sales of electric cars have risen strikingly in the past five years.
ex.zh: 过去五年，电动汽车的销量显著上升。

string.usage: 记：本身为词根，意为“束缚”→束缚物体的细长东西→线；[近]series n.一系列；同义: band, tie; thread；绳string编戒指送她；拓展：a string of lucrative awards 一系列丰厚的奖项；索引p417

ex.en: a string of accidents
ex.zh: 一系列事故

ex.en: The key is hanging on a string by the door.
ex.zh: 钥匙拴在门边的带子上。

ex.en: The company suffered a string of failures before it finally went bankrupt.
ex.zh: 这家公司在最终破产前经历了一连串失败。

senses: adj. 严格的;严厉的;严重的;紧缩的,银根紧的

phrases.m: 从 B 上剥去 A

strip.usage: 辨析：strip 指剥去衣服或覆盖物,喻指全然剥夺；rob 指公然用暴力抢劫；deprive 指夺去必要的、有价值的东西,多指剥夺权利等抽象的东西；索引p417

ex.en: Downloading and consuming culture requires great skills, but failing to move beyond downloading is to strip oneself of a defining constituent of humanity.
ex.zh: 下载（模式）和消费的文化需要高超的技能，但是如果仅限于下载（模式），则无异于剥夺了人之所以为人的定义性要素。

ex.en: The new law would strip corrupt officials of their pensions.
ex.zh: 新法律将剥夺腐败官员的养老金。

ex.en: He stripped the old paint from the door before repainting it.
ex.zh: 他把门上的旧漆刮掉，然后重新粉刷。

senses: n. 条纹；线条；种类，类型

ex.en: Scholars, policymakers, and critics of all stripes have debated the social implications of these changes.
ex.zh: 学者、政策制定者以及各界评论人士就这些变化的社会影响展开了讨论。

ex.en: The tiger's stripes help it hide in tall grass.
ex.zh: 老虎的条纹有助于它在深草中隐藏。

ex.en: She wore a navy skirt with white stripes.
ex.zh: 她穿着一条带白色条纹的藏青色裙子。

strive.usage: struggle 的近义词；过去式 strove/strived。近义：struggle vi. 奋斗；v.努力，力争；发音类似“死拽我”→只能努力奋斗。；索引p417

ex.en: The most successful monarchies strive to abandon or hide their old aristocratic ways.
ex.zh: 最成功的君主政体都在努力摆脱或隐藏其原有的贵族习气。

ex.en: The most successful monarchies strive to abandon or hide their old aristocratic ways.
ex.zh: 最成功的王室成员努力舍弃或隐藏其原有的贵族生活方式。

ex.en: The best teachers strive to make difficult ideas accessible without oversimplifying them.
ex.zh: 最优秀的教师努力让深奥的观点变得通俗易懂，同时又不将其过度简化。

ex.en: He suffered a stroke last year and has not worked since.
ex.zh: 他去年中风，此后一直没有工作。

ex.en: She finished the painting with a few deft strokes of the brush.
ex.zh: 她用几笔熟练的笔触完成了这幅画。

ex.en: The cat enjoyed being stroked behind its ears.
ex.zh: 那只猫喜欢被抚摸耳朵后面。

senses: n. & v. 散步；溜达；闲逛
stroll.usage: 派生 stroller n. 散步者,闲逛者；发音类似“四周”→我在四周“散步；闲逛；溜达”。；索引p417

ex.en: People were strolling along the beach.
ex.zh: 人们在海滩漫步。

ex.en: After dinner, the old couple took a leisurely stroll in the park.
ex.zh: 晚饭后，老两口在公园里悠闲地散步。

ex.en: We decided to stroll around the old town to enjoy its unique atmosphere.
ex.zh: 我们决定在老城四处走走，感受它独特的氛围。

senses: a. 强壮的；强劲的；强烈的；有权势的；确凿的
strong.usage: adj.健壮的；坚固的；强烈的， 坚定的

ex.en: There is strong evidence that regular reading improves memory.
ex.zh: 有确凿的证据表明，经常阅读能改善记忆力。

ex.en: The economy remains strong despite rising interest rates.
ex.zh: 尽管利率上升，经济依然强劲。

ex.en: She has strong opinions about how schools should be run.
ex.zh: 她对学校应当如何管理持有强烈的看法。

senses: adj. 结构的,构造上的;建筑上的,建筑用的
adj. 结构性的；结构上的

ex.en: The report identifies serious structural weaknesses in the country's economy.
ex.zh: 报告指出了该国经济中严重的结构性弱点。

ex.en: Engineers found structural damage to the bridge after the earthquake.
ex.zh: 工程师在地震后发现桥梁出现了结构性损坏。

ex.en: Unemployment is not just a personal problem but a structural one.
ex.zh: 失业不仅是个人问题，更是结构性问题。

senses: n. 结构体,(尤指)建筑物
structure.usage: 词根记忆: struct(build, 建造)+ure(名词后缀)→结构；真 regulatory structure 监管架构；population structure 人口结构；well-structured daily plans 安排良好的每日计划；索引p417

ex.en: For example, a high growth rate placed great strains on the existing structures of governance, of administration, and above all of socialization.
ex.zh: 例如,高增长率给现有的治理结构、行政管理结构、尤其是社会化结构带来了巨大压力。

ex.en: The report examines the structure of the country's education system.
ex.zh: 该报告考察了这个国家教育体系的结构。

ex.en: Engineers must make sure the structure can withstand strong earthquakes.
ex.zh: 工程师必须确保这一建筑结构能经受强烈地震。

struggle.usage: 近义：strive v. 努力，奋斗；v.奋斗，努力；斗争；索引p417

ex.en: I struggled a lot to get the college degree.
ex.zh: 为了获得大学学位，我付出了很多努力。

ex.en: Many small businesses are struggling to survive in the economic downturn.
ex.zh: 许多小企业在经济低迷中挣扎求生。

ex.en: Her struggle for equal pay inspired millions of working women.
ex.zh: 她为同工同酬进行的斗争激励了数百万职业女性。

senses: adj. 顽固的,倔强的,顽强的,坚持的
adj. 动不了的,无法移动的,卡住的;被难住的;答不上来的;不知所措的;(为某事)犯愁的;摆脱不了的
n. 制片厂,画室,摄影室
adv. 刻意地;小心地;成心地
n. 原料,材料,物品,东西

ex.en: The reason for this is simple: The longer you stay in the store, the more stuff you'll see, and the more stuff you see, the more you'll buy.
ex.zh: 原因很简单：你在店里待的时间越长，你看到的东西越多，而你看到的东西越多，你就会买得越多。

ex.en: Please clear your stuff off the table before the meeting starts.
ex.zh: 开会前请把你的东西从桌上收拾走。

ex.en: The attic was stuffed with old furniture and boxes of papers.
ex.zh: 阁楼里塞满了旧家具和一箱箱文件。

senses: vi. 绊脚，跌跌撞撞地走
v. 绊倒；跌跌撞撞地走
v. 使震惊,使晕倒,把……打晕
v. 给(某人)以深刻印象,使深深感动
v. 使震惊；打昏；给以深刻的印象
stun.usage: 发音类似“使打”→不能使劲打他，不然就把他“打昏”了。

ex.en: The guests were stunned into silence.
ex.zh: 客人们惊愕万分，一片哑然。

ex.en: The election result stunned political observers around the world.
ex.zh: 选举结果震惊了世界各地的政治观察人士。

ex.en: The blow stunned the boxer, and the referee stopped the fight.
ex.zh: 这一击把拳击手打得发懵，裁判终止了比赛。

ex.en: We stock a wide variety of styles and sizes.
ex.zh: 我们有各种款式各种尺码的货品。

ex.en: The building was designed in the traditional style of the region.
ex.zh: 这座建筑是按该地区的传统风格设计的。

ex.en: I like her writing style: clear, simple and full of humor.
ex.zh: 我喜欢她的写作风格：清晰、简洁且充满幽默。

senses: adj. 时髦的,新潮的;雅致的;有气派的
stylish.usage: adj.时髦的，流行的，有格调的

ex.en: The hotel is stylish without being expensive.
ex.zh: 这家酒店时尚而不昂贵。

ex.en: She always wears simple but stylish clothes.
ex.zh: 她总是穿着简约而时尚的衣服。

ex.en: The new library is a stylish blend of glass and steel.
ex.zh: 新图书馆是玻璃与钢的时尚结合。

senses: n. 文体家;发型师,美容师
n. (产品、人、广告等的)造型师,形象设计师;时装设计师
n. (体育运动或音乐)表现得有格调的人
n. 造型设计师；文体家

ex.en: She trained as a hair stylist before moving into fashion design.
ex.zh: 她在转入时装设计之前接受过发型师培训。

ex.en: The magazine's food stylist arranged the dishes for the photograph.
ex.zh: 杂志的美食造型师为拍摄摆好了菜肴。

ex.en: A good stylist can transform an ordinary outfit into something striking.
ex.zh: 好的造型师能把一身普通的装扮变得惹眼。

senses: 副；在下面；下；由下向上；后面；靠近
adj. 下意识的,潜意识的
subconscious.usage: adj.下意识的，潜意识的 n.下意识，潜意识；索引p417

ex.en: Our subconscious minds process far more information than we realize.
ex.zh: 我们的潜意识处理的信息远远超出我们的想象。

ex.en: Her fear of water may have subconscious roots in a childhood accident.
ex.zh: 她对水的恐惧可能在潜意识里源于童年的一次事故。

ex.en: Advertisers try to send messages straight to the subconscious.
ex.zh: 广告商试图把信息直接传递到潜意识。

subject.usage: 词根词缀法：sub（表示“往下”）+ject（抛，扔）→把你扔到我的下面去→使服从，使顺从。；sub（往下）+ject（抛，扔）→往下扔，扔到我下面→使服从；词根记忆：sub(under,在…之下)+ject(throw,扔,投)→被扔在下面的→服从于…的；②服从于…的(2012年阅读)；索引p417

ex.en: All nuclear installations are subject to international safeguards.
ex.zh: 一切核设施均须执行国际防护措施。

ex.en: In a Swiss study, researchers sprayed oxytocin into the noses of half the subjects; those subjects were ready to lend significantly higher amounts of money to strangers than were their counterparts who inhaled something else.
ex.zh: 在瑞士的一项研究中，研究人员将催产素喷入一半实验对象的鼻子里；比起吸入其他东西的另一半人，这些实验对象愿意借出更多的钱给陌生人。

ex.en: Mathematics is her favorite subject at school.
ex.zh: 数学是她在学校最喜欢的科目。

senses: a. 主观的；主观想象的；主语的
subjective.usage: adj.主观的；主语的 n.(语法)主格

ex.en: Taste is such a subjective matter that we don't usually conduct preference tests for food.
ex.zh: 味觉是一个如此主观的问题，以至我们通常不会对食物进行偏好测试。

ex.en: Beauty is subjective, and everyone has his or her own standards.
ex.zh: 美是主观的，每个人都有自己的标准。

ex.en: Judging an art competition is inevitably subjective to some degree.
ex.zh: 评判艺术比赛在某种程度上不可避免地带有主观性。

submerge.usage: sub-(下)+merg(沉)→沉到下面→淹没；[反] emerge 出现；[族] submergence n. 淹没；sub（下面）+merg（沉没）+e→沉没到下面去了→淹没

ex.en: The fields had been submerged by floodwater.
ex.zh: 农田被洪水淹没了。

ex.en: The submarine submerged just before the storm reached the area.
ex.zh: 潜艇在暴风雨到达该海域前刚好潜入水中。

ex.en: Heavy rains submerged dozens of villages along the river.
ex.zh: 大雨淹没了沿河的数十个村庄。

senses: n. 屈从,归顺,投降;提交,呈递
submission.usage: n.屈服，投降；提交；submit 的派生词

ex.en: The deadline for submission of applications is the end of March.
ex.zh: 提交申请的截止日期是三月底。

ex.en: Faced with the threat of dismissal, the staff chose submission rather than protest.
ex.zh: 面对解雇的威胁，员工们选择了屈服而不是抗议。

ex.en: The journal welcomes the submission of original research papers.
ex.zh: 该期刊欢迎提交原创研究论文。

submit.usage: sub-（下）+mit（送）→从下往上送→提交。近义：surrender v. 投降；屈服；同义: yield, obey, comply, surrender; 反义: resist；从下面（sub）送（mit），从下面给别人递上一个东西→呈递，提交；词根记忆: sub(under, 下)+mit(send, 送)→

ex.en: A team of researchers working together in the laboratory would submit the results of their research to a journal.
ex.zh: 在实验室通力合作的一组研究人员将他们的研究成果提交给某刊物。

ex.en: At the same time, Dickens, who had a reporter's eye for transcribing the life around him, especially anything comic or odd, submitted short sketches to obscure magazines.
ex.zh: 同时，狄更斯拥有记者般敏锐的洞察力，可以记录周围生活，尤其是一些滑稽或怪诞的事情，向一些不知名的杂志投了一些短篇随笔。

ex.en: Applicants must submit their forms before the end of the month or lose their place in the queue.
ex.zh: 申请者必须在月底前提交表格，否则将失去排队资格。

senses: adj. 下级的，从属的；次要的
subordinate.usage: 同义: inferior, secondary; 反义: superior；sub（在下面）+ordinate（联想ordinary“普通的”）→在普通之下→下级，部属。；索引p417

ex.en: You're seen not as a disagreeable subordinate but as a colleague who's trying to advance a common objective.
ex.zh: 你不会被看作是一个话不投机的下属，而是会被视为一个努力推进共同目标的同事。

ex.en: In the past, women were often regarded as subordinate to men in the family.
ex.zh: 过去，女性在家庭中常被视为从属于男性。

ex.en: A good manager listens to the opinions of his subordinates before making a decision.
ex.zh: 优秀的管理者在做决定前会听取下属的意见。

subscribe.usage: 同义: donate, contribute, approve, support；sub（下面）+scribe（写）→写在下面→订阅一个东西时不是要在下面写上名字→订购，订阅；词根记忆：sub(under，在下面)+scrib(write，写)+e→在文件下面写名字→订阅；索引p417

ex.en: Which journals does the library subscribe to?
ex.zh: 图书馆订有哪些报刊？

ex.en: Copyright rested with the journal publisher, and researchers seeking knowledge of the results would have to subscribe to the journal.
ex.zh: 论文版权归期刊出版商所有，想了解实验结果的研究者要订阅期刊才能阅读该论文。

ex.en: Fewer readers now subscribe to printed newspapers, preferring free news on their phones.
ex.zh: 如今订阅印刷报纸的读者越来越少，他们更倾向于在手机上免费获取新闻。

senses: n. 预订者,订阅者;捐款者,出资者;用户,消费者

ex.en: The magazine has lost nearly a third of its subscribers in five years.
ex.zh: 五年内，这本杂志失去了近三分之一的订户。

ex.en: Subscribers receive the print edition and full access to the digital archive.
ex.zh: 订阅者可获得印刷版以及数字档案的完整访问权限。

ex.en: The telecom company promised faster internet for rural subscribers.
ex.zh: 这家电信公司承诺为农村用户提供更快的互联网服务。

subsequent.usage: sub-(后)+sequ(跟随)+-ent→跟在后面的→随后的；反义: previous；adj.随后的，接着的；sub(下面)+sequent(连续的)→下面连续的，还有的→后来的，随后的；索引p417

ex.en: Developments on this issue will be dealt with in a subsequent report.
ex.zh: 这个问题的发展将在以后的报道中予以说明。

ex.en: The initial report was heavily criticised, and subsequent studies failed to repeat its findings.
ex.zh: 最初的报告受到严厉批评，随后的研究也未能重复其结果。

ex.en: He was dismissed for leaking documents, and his subsequent attempts to find work elsewhere failed.
ex.zh: 他因泄露文件被解雇，此后到别处找工作的尝试均告失败。

subsidise.usage: 亦拼作 subsidize；[族] subsidy n. 补贴

senses: vt. 给……发津贴；补助；出资支持
v. 资助；补助；给……发津贴
v. 资助;补助;给……发津贴

subsidy.usage: n.补贴，津贴；sub(下，辅助的)+side(旁边)→作为辅助的、在旁边支撑你生活的收入→津贴，补贴；索引p417

ex.en: Anyway, the townsfolk can't understand why the Royal Shakespeare Company needs a subsidy.
ex.zh: 无论如何，镇民们不明白为什么皇家莎士比亚剧团需要补贴。

ex.en: Critics argue that the farm subsidy programme mainly benefits large landowners rather than small family farms.
ex.zh: 批评者认为，农业补贴计划主要让大地主受益，而不是小型家庭农场。

ex.en: Without a government subsidy, the rural bus service would have to close completely.
ex.zh: 如果没有政府补贴，乡村巴士服务将不得不完全停运。

senses: n. 要旨,基本内容;实质,本质

phrases.m: 本质上,基本上,大体上,实际上

substance.usage: 同义: material, matter；sub(表示"下面")+stan(=stand，表示"站")+ce→站在最下面的东西是什么？→实质；索引p417

ex.en: The real substance of the report was in the third part.
ex.zh: 这篇报告的实质性内容在第三部分。

ex.en: Scientists found a harmful substance in the bottled water.
ex.zh: 科学家在瓶装水中发现了一种有害物质。

ex.en: His speech was long on words but short on substance.
ex.zh: 他的讲话篇幅很长，却缺乏实质内容。

senses: adj. 大量的,富裕的;重要的

ex.en: In its latest survey of CEO pay, The Wall Street Journal finds that "a substantial part" of executive pay is now tied to performance.
ex.zh: 《华尔街日报》在CEO薪酬最新调查中发现，如今，高管薪酬中"相当大一部分"与业绩紧密相关。

ex.en: It is all very well train operators trumpeting the improvements they are making to the network, but passengers should be able to expect a basic level of service for the substantial sums they are now paying to travel.
ex.zh: 火车运营商大肆宣扬他们对铁路系统做出的改进无可非议，但考虑到如今乘客为出行支付的大笔费用，他们理应可以期待享受基本水准的铁路服务。

ex.en: The museum's expansion required a substantial donation from a private foundation.
ex.zh: 博物馆的扩建需要一家私人基金会提供一笔可观的捐款。

senses: adv. 非常地,巨大地;基本上,大体上,很大程度上
substantially.usage: substantial（大量的）+ly→大幅度地；adv.大量地；大体上，基本上；索引p417

ex.en: The cost of solar power has fallen substantially over the last decade.
ex.zh: 过去十年，太阳能发电的成本大幅下降。

ex.en: The two proposals are substantially different in their approach to climate change.
ex.zh: 这两项提案在应对气候变化的方法上大不相同。

ex.en: Her salary increased substantially after she changed jobs.
ex.zh: 换工作后，她的薪水大幅提高。

substitute.usage: 辨析: substitute 多指暂时或部分替换; replace 强调长期或永久替代; displace 强调从原位置移开并被替代；sub（在下边）+stitut（=stand“站”）+e→站在后台等待登场的是“替补”人员。；2019年阅读例：High sympathy can substitute for low

ex.en: Devoted concertgoers who reply that recordings are no substitute for live performance are missing the point.
ex.zh: 那些忠实的音乐会观众反驳说现场演出绝非唱片所能替代，但是他们没有看到问题的实质。

ex.en: You can use honey as a substitute for sugar in this recipe.
ex.zh: 在这个食谱里，你可以用蜂蜜代替糖。

ex.en: Nothing can substitute for a good night's sleep.
ex.zh: 什么也替代不了一夜好眠。

senses: n. 副标题;说明或对白的字幕
n. 副标题；(电影或电视上的)字幕
vt. 给…加副标题；给(电影等)加字幕
subtitle.usage: n.字幕；副标题 v.为...提供字幕；词根记忆：sub(down,副)+title(标题)→副标题。；索引p417

ex.en: The film is in French with English subtitles.
ex.zh: 这部电影是法语片，配有英文字幕。

ex.en: The book's subtitle explains its central argument.
ex.zh: 这本书的副标题点明了其核心论点。

ex.en: The director subtitled the documentary for international audiences.
ex.zh: 导演为这部纪录片添加了字幕，以面向国际观众。

senses: a. 微妙的；不易察觉的
adj. 细心的,敏锐的;精妙的,灵巧的
subtle.usage: adj.微妙的；巧妙的；含蓄的；派生：subtly；subtlety；索引p417

ex.en: This is a subtle form of peer pressure: we unconsciously imitate the behavior we see every day.
ex.zh: 这是一种微妙的同侪压力：我们会无意识地模仿每天看到的行为。

ex.en: This is a subtle form of peer pressure: we unconsciously imitate the behavior we see every day.
ex.zh: 这是同辈压力的一种微妙的体现形式：我们会不知不觉地模仿我们每天看到的行为。

ex.en: Advertising often works through subtle cues that shape our preferences without our noticing.
ex.zh: 广告往往通过微妙的暗示发挥作用，在不知不觉中塑造我们的偏好。

phrases.m: 从 B 中减去 A

subtract.usage: 派生 subtraction n. 减,减法；sub（表示“往下”）+tract（拽，拉）→往下拽→减去，扣除。

ex.en: We have subtracted $25 per adult to arrive at a basic room rate.
ex.zh: 我们已给每位成人房客减去了25美元，这就是基本的房费价格了。

ex.en: Subtract the fixed costs from the total revenue to calculate the profit.
ex.zh: 从总收入中减去固定成本即可算出利润。

ex.en: Children learn to subtract two-digit numbers in primary school.
ex.zh: 孩子们在上小学时学习两位数减法。

suburb.usage: 在市区（urb联想成urban）的下面（sub），就是“郊区”。

ex.en: They live in the suburbs.
ex.zh: 他们住在郊区。

ex.en: Many young families are moving to the suburbs in search of affordable housing.
ex.zh: 许多年轻家庭为了寻找负担得起的住房而搬到郊区。

ex.en: The factory moved from the city center to an industrial suburb.
ex.zh: 工厂从市中心迁到了近郊工业区。

senses: a. 郊区的；城外的；平淡乏味的；呆板的
adj. 郊区的,城外的;平淡乏味的
adj. 郊区的；平淡乏味的

ex.en: Many young families are moving to suburban areas in search of affordable housing.
ex.zh: 许多年轻家庭为了寻找负担得起的住房而搬到郊区。

ex.en: He grew tired of his quiet suburban life and moved downtown.
ex.zh: 他厌倦了安静的郊区生活，搬到了市中心。

ex.en: The suburban railway line will be extended to serve more commuters.
ex.zh: 郊区铁路线将得到延长，以服务更多通勤者。

senses: v. 达到目的,成功,有作为

phrases.m: 在高等教育中有所建树

succeed.usage: v.成功，达成；继任，接任；接替， 随后出现；联想记忆：和success一起记，注意结尾的ess变成了eed；索引p417

ex.en: If you keep working hard, you will succeed in the end.
ex.zh: 只要坚持努力，你终会成功。

ex.en: Who will succeed the founder as chief executive remains unknown.
ex.zh: 谁将接替创始人出任首席执行官仍不得而知。

ex.en: The prince succeeded to the throne after his father's death.
ex.zh: 父亲去世后，王子继承了王位。

senses: n. 成功,胜利,成名;成功的人(或事物)
success.usage: n.成功，胜利；成功的人；索引p417

ex.en: The success of the project depended on the cooperation of every member.
ex.zh: 项目的成功取决于每一位成员的合作。

ex.en: She worked hard for years before she achieved success as a writer.
ex.zh: 她努力多年，才作为作家获得成功。

ex.en: The vaccine trial proved a great success.
ex.zh: 该疫苗试验取得了巨大成功。

senses: a. 成功的；有成就的；有成效的
adj. 达到目的的,有成效的,获得成功的

ex.en: The company launched a successful advertising campaign last autumn.
ex.zh: 去年秋天，该公司发起了一场成功的广告宣传。

ex.en: She is one of the most successful novelists of her generation.
ex.zh: 她是同代人中最成功的小说家之一。

ex.en: A successful negotiation requires patience and careful preparation.
ex.zh: 成功的谈判需要耐心和周密的准备。

senses: n. 一连串，一系列，连续的人（或事物）
succession.usage: 反义interval n.间隔；suc（往下）+cess（走）+ion（名词后缀）→往下走→连续的人或事物；词根记忆：suc(after,在…之后)+cess(go,走)+ion(名词后缀)→一个一个走在后面→连续；索引p417

ex.en: She has won the award for the third year in succession.
ex.zh: 这是她连续第三年获得此奖。

ex.en: As boards scrutinize succession plans in response to shareholder pressure, executives who don't get the nod also may wish to move on.
ex.zh: 由于董事会迫于股东们的压力而严格审查公司的继任方案，那些未获得继任资格的高管也可能想另谋他业。

ex.en: A succession of bad harvests forced the government to import grain.
ex.zh: 接连的歉收迫使政府进口粮食。

successive.usage: consecutive 的近义词；adj.连续的，依次的；接替的，继 承的；索引p417

ex.en: Successive governments have promised to cut hospital waiting lists, yet the queues keep growing.
ex.zh: 历届政府都承诺缩短医院候诊名单，但排队人数仍在不断增加。

ex.en: The team suffered three successive defeats, and supporters began to question the coach's tactics.
ex.zh: 这支球队连遭三场败绩，球迷开始质疑教练的战术。

ex.en: Successive harvests failed because of drought, pushing food prices to record highs.
ex.zh: 干旱导致庄稼连年歉收，把粮价推至历史最高点。

senses: n. 继承人，接任者；后续的事物
successor.usage: n.继承者，接任者；通过success记忆：最成功的事是继承王位→继承人

ex.en: She has been appointed as his successor.
ex.zh: 她已被指定为他的接班人。

ex.en: The old manager spent months training his successor.
ex.zh: 老经理花了数月时间培训自己的继任者。

ex.en: So far, no obvious successor to the smartphone has appeared.
ex.zh: 到目前为止，还没有出现明显的智能手机接替者。

senses: det./pron. 类似的；下述一类的

ex.en: The plant sucks moisture from the soil through its roots.
ex.zh: 植物通过根从土壤中吸取水分。

ex.en: The child sucked orange juice through a straw.
ex.zh: 孩子用吸管吮吸橙汁。

ex.en: The whirlpool sucked the small boat under the water.
ex.zh: 漩涡把小船吸入了水下。

senses: a. 突然的；忽然的；骤然的
sudden.usage: 派生 suddenness n. 突然,意外

senses: adv. 突然地,出乎意料地

sue.usage: [近] prosecute vt. 起诉；近义：prosecute vt. 起诉；检控；同义①accuse,charge②appeal；单词发音类似“诉”→起诉。；索引p417

ex.en: The consumer sued the company for selling faulty products.
ex.zh: 这名消费者因公司销售劣质产品而对其提起诉讼。

ex.en: If the factory refuses to compensate the victims, they will sue for damages.
ex.zh: 如果工厂拒绝赔偿受害者，他们将提起损害赔偿诉讼。

ex.en: He threatened to sue the newspaper for spreading false stories about him.
ex.zh: 他威胁要起诉这家报纸散布关于他的不实报道。

suffer.usage: 发音类似“仨佛”（和尚）→一个和尚挑水喝，两个和尚抬水喝，三个和尚没水喝→遭受；忍受。；索引p417

ex.en: Like the majority of authors, he had to suffer many disappointments and rejections along the way.
ex.zh: 和大多数作家一样，他在写作过程中经历了许多失望和拒绝。

ex.en: But many within the public sector suffer under the current system, too.
ex.zh: 但是在现行体制下，公共部门许多人的日子也并不好过。

ex.en: Coastal towns suffer frequent flooding, and insurers are refusing to renew their policies.
ex.zh: 沿海城镇频频遭受洪灾，保险公司正拒绝为其续保。

senses: v. 足够,有能力,使满足

phrases.m: 满足(某人)或(某物)之需要的

ex.en: No words will suffice to convey my grief.
ex.zh: 没有言语能够表达我的悲伤。

ex.en: A brief summary will suffice for the purposes of this report.
ex.zh: 就本报告而言，一份简短的概述就足够了。

ex.en: One example should suffice to illustrate the point.
ex.zh: 一个例子就足以说明这一点。

ex.en: Some people argue that food self-sufficiency in the UK would contribute to the nation's well-being.
ex.zh: 有些人认为，英国的粮食自给自足有助于国家的福祉。

phrases.m: 对某人或某事物是足够的

sufficient.usage: [近] adequate a. 充分的；enough a. 足够的；adequate 的近义词；suf（向下）+fic（做）+ient（形容词后缀）→先做好→足够的；索引p417

ex.en: Our budget is hardly sufficient to pay people, let alone buy any new equipment.
ex.zh: 我们的预算几乎不够支付工资，更不用说买新设备了。

ex.en: What makes the problem thornier is that the usual time-management techniques don't seem sufficient.
ex.zh: 令这一问题更加棘手的是，通常的时间管理技巧似乎并不够。

ex.en: A single year of data is not sufficient to prove that the climate pattern has truly changed.
ex.zh: 仅一年的数据不足以证明气候模式真的发生了变化。

senses: vt. 建议；表明；暗示；推荐

ex.en: This suggests the possibility that lifestyle factors might help prevent or delay this type of decline.
ex.zh: 这表明，生活方式的因素有可能帮助我们阻止或者推迟这种衰退。

ex.en: The recent data suggest that the economy is slowly recovering.
ex.zh: 最新的数据表明经济正在缓慢复苏。

ex.en: I suggest we postpone the meeting until everyone has read the report.
ex.zh: 我建议把会议推迟到大家都读完报告之后。

senses: n. 建议,提议;联想,暗示(c)

ex.en: Your suggestion that the meeting be canceled has been accepted.
ex.zh: 你提出的取消会议的建议已被接受。

ex.en: At her suggestion, we changed the date of the conference.
ex.zh: 根据她的建议，我们更改了会议日期。

ex.en: There is no suggestion that the company broke any law.
ex.zh: 没有任何迹象表明该公司违反了法律。

suicide.usage: n.自杀；自杀者；自杀性的行 为；sui（自己）+cide（切，杀）→自杀；索引p417

ex.en: As a leader he knows that it is political suicide to appear indecisive.
ex.zh: 作为一位领袖，他知道表现得犹疑不定是在政治上自取灭亡。

ex.en: Teenage suicide rates have risen in cities where social media use is heaviest, researchers report.
ex.zh: 研究人员报告称，在社交媒体使用最普遍的城市，青少年自杀率有所上升。

ex.en: Pulling out of the alliance now would be economic suicide for the small country.
ex.zh: 现在退出联盟对这个小国来说无异于经济自杀。

suit.usage: 联想记忆：和suite(n. 一套家具；套房)一起记忆，注意拼写的不同；n.义2012年真题例：other suits may have an even greater impact；索引p417

ex.en: John Donahue at Harvard's Kennedy School points out that the norms of culture in Western civil services suit those who want to stay put but is bad for high achievers.
ex.zh: 哈佛大学肯尼迪学院的约翰·多纳休指出，西方公务员的文化模式适合那些希望安于现状的人，但对取得卓越成就的人来说却不利。

ex.en: He wore a dark suit to the job interview.
ex.zh: 他穿着一套深色西装去参加工作面试。

ex.en: Choose a course that suits your interests and career plans.
ex.zh: 选择一门适合你兴趣和职业规划的课程。

ex.en: This film is not suitable for young children.
ex.zh: 这部电影不适合幼儿观看。

ex.en: The committee is searching for a suitable candidate for the post.
ex.zh: 委员会正在为该职位寻找合适的人选。

ex.en: The land is suitable for growing wheat but not for rice.
ex.zh: 这片土地适合种小麦，但不适合种水稻。

senses: n. (一套)家具,套房,(音乐)组曲

sum.usage: 拓展：in sum 总而言之；索引p417

ex.en: It sounds like they've been sitting on the porch together, attempting to sum up their lives.
ex.zh: 听起来他们好像坐在门廊上，试图总结他们的生活。

ex.en: To sum up: a system of conservation based solely on economic self-interest is hopelessly lopsided.
ex.zh: 总之，一个仅仅基于经济利己主义的保护制度存在着无可救药的片面性。

ex.en: He paid a large sum of money for the old painting.
ex.zh: 他花了一大笔钱买下这幅古画。

summarise.usage: summary 的派生词（美式拼作 summarize）

ex.en: The results of the research are summarised at the end of the chapter.
ex.zh: 在这一章末尾对研究结果作了总结。

summarise-ize.usage: 词根记忆：summ(total,总)+ar(y)(名词后缀)+ize(动词后缀)→总结。；索引p417

ex.en: summarize the main idea of the text
ex.zh: 总结文章大意

summarize.usage: summary（摘要）+ize→做摘要→总结。名词 summary 摘要；记：sum(总)+mar+-ize(动后缀)→汇总分析后简短说明→总结；亦作summarise；[族]summary n.概括；[近]outline vt.概述

ex.en: summarize the main idea of the text
ex.zh: 概括文章主旨

senses: adj. 概括的,总结性的,扼要的
summary.usage: 派生 summarize v. 总结,概括；派生：summarise（美 summarize）

ex.en: The book provides useful summaries of the arguments.
ex.zh: 这本书对这些论点进行了有益的总结。

ex.en: In summary, the report calls for urgent investment in public transport.
ex.zh: 总而言之，该报告呼吁紧急投资公共交通。

ex.en: Each chapter ends with a brief summary of its main points.
ex.zh: 每章结尾都对要点作了简要总结。

senses: adj. 最高级的,政府首脑的
n. 最高点，顶峰；峰会（最高级会议）
summit.usage: 联想记忆: sum(m)(add up, 加)+it→全都叠加到一起→最高的→顶峰；索引p417

ex.en: As we approached the summit, we were lucky to see the rare vision.
ex.zh: 快到山顶时，我们有幸看到了难得一见的景象。

ex.en: When women do break through to the summit of corporate power—as, for example, Sheryl Sandberg recently did at Facebook—they attract massive attention precisely because they remain the exception to the rule.
ex.zh: 而当女性突破重围，到达了公司权力的顶峰，就会引起很大的关注，比如脸书的首席运营官谢丽尔·桑德伯格最近那样，只因为她们是这个社会规则的例外。

ex.en: Leaders from ten countries attended the summit on climate change.
ex.zh: 来自十个国家的领导人出席了此次气候变化峰会。

senses: vt. 使出,鼓起(勇气),振作(精神)
v. 召唤，召集；鼓起；振作；传唤，传讯（出庭）
summon.usage: 他们决定在夏天(summer)召集(summon)会议；索引p417

ex.en: They summoned men to defend their country.
ex.zh: 他们召集男人来保卫国家。

ex.en: She had to summon all her courage to tell the truth.
ex.zh: 她不得不鼓起全部勇气说出真相。

ex.en: The witness was summoned to appear in court on Monday.
ex.zh: 这名证人被传唤于周一出庭。

senses: n. （常用 the sun）[U,sing.] 阳光；日光
a. 卓越的；极佳的；质量极高的
adj. 极好的,一流的,杰出的,高质量的
adj. 极佳的，卓越的，质量极高的
adj. 质量极高的；极佳的
superb.usage: 同义excellent,famous,splendid,perfect;反义wretched adj.品质很差的；super(超越)+b(联想不)→不能被超越的→极佳的；索引p417

ex.en: He got a superb chance to show his talent.
ex.zh: 他得到了一个极好的机会来展示他的才能。

ex.en: The hotel offers superb views of the mountains.
ex.zh: 这家酒店可以饱览群山的壮丽景色。

ex.en: The orchestra gave a superb performance last night.
ex.zh: 昨晚乐团的演出极为精彩。

superficial.usage: 反义profound adj.深刻的;典型考题see through the __phenomenon选C.superficial(区别shallow/external/apparent)；super（在……上面）+fic（做）+ial→在表面上做的→肤浅的

ex.en: The book shows only a superficial understanding of the historical context.
ex.zh: 这本书只表现出对历史背景肤浅的理解。

ex.en: A superficial examination of the data may lead to wrong conclusions.
ex.zh: 对数据只作肤浅的考察可能导致错误的结论。

ex.en: Their friendship remained superficial despite years of working together.
ex.zh: 尽管共事多年，他们的友谊仍停留在表面。

senses: adj. 过多的,剩余的,多余的
adj. 多余的；不必要的；过剩的
superfluous.usage: adj.多余的，过剩的；super（超过）+flu（发音类似“福”）+ous（形容词后缀）→给他超过的东西就是不必要的→多余的。；词根记忆:super(超…的)+flu+ous(形容词后缀)→超过数量的→过剩的；索引p417

ex.en: Of course, it is precisely these superfluous things that define human culture and ultimately what it is to be human.
ex.zh: 当然，正是这些额外事物定义了人类文化，并最终定义了什么是人。

ex.en: Of course, it is precisely these superfluous things that define human culture and ultimately what it is to be human.
ex.zh: 当然，正是这些丰富的成果界定了人类文化的内涵并最终决定了什么是人类。

ex.en: Cut every superfluous word from the essay; precision, not length, earns high marks.
ex.zh: 把文章中每一个多余的词都删掉；得高分靠的是精准，而非篇幅。

senses: a. 职位更高的；上级的
superior.usage: 记：super(超过)+-ior(形后缀)→职位超过其他人→职位更高的；[近]ranking a.地位高的；[反]inferior a.较差的；superior（优质的）vs senior（年长的）；adj.更好的；更高的；高傲的 n.上级，上司；super(超越,在…上面)+i+or(人)→在你上面的人→上司；sup

ex.en: superior intelligence
ex.zh: 更强的智力

ex.en: She felt socially superior to most of her neighbours.
ex.zh: 她觉得自己的社会地位比多数邻居高。

ex.en: He adds humbly that perhaps he was "superior to the common run of men in noticing things which easily escape attention, and in observing them carefully."
ex.zh: 他谦虚地补充道：或许自己“在注意到容易被忽略的事物，并对其加以仔细观察方面优于常人”。

superiority.usage: 记：super(超过)+-ior+-ity(名后缀)→自以为超过别人的心理→优越感；[近]advantage n.优势；[反]inferiority n.劣势；n.优越，优势；优越感；索引p417

ex.en: They tend to have a sense of superiority over their peers.
ex.zh: 他们往往比同龄人有优越感。

ex.en: The firm's technological superiority allows it to charge premium prices for ordinary products.
ex.zh: 该公司凭借技术优势得以对普通产品收取高价。

ex.en: His air of superiority alienated colleagues who might otherwise have supported his reforms.
ex.zh: 他那副优越感十足的样子疏远了原本可能支持他改革的同事。

superstition.usage: 派生 superstitiously adv. 迷信地；superstitious adj. 由迷信引起的；n.迷信；super(上面)+stit(联想stand站)+ion→站在科学之上→迷信；索引p417

ex.en: Their thinking often had a traditional superstitions quality.
ex.zh: 他们的想法往往有一种传统的迷信特征。

ex.en: Science replaces superstition only when education teaches people how to test their beliefs.
ex.zh: 只有当教育教会人们如何检验自己的信念时，科学才能取代迷信。

ex.en: The custom survived long after its origin had been forgotten, kept alive by pure superstition.
ex.zh: 这一习俗在起源早已被遗忘之后仍延续了很长时间，全靠迷信得以维持。

supervise.usage: super（在上）+vis（看）→从上看→监督。近义：oversee vt. 监督；同义control,run,oversee；词根记忆：super(over, 在上面)+vis(look, 看)→从上向下看→监督；索引p417

ex.en: In 1924 America's National Research Council sent two engineers to supervise a series of experiments at a telephone-parts factory.
ex.zh: 1924年，美国国家研究委员会派了两名工程师到一家电话零件工厂监督一系列实验。

ex.en: Experienced teachers will supervise the students during their laboratory work.
ex.zh: 经验丰富的教师将在学生做实验时进行指导。

ex.en: A special committee was set up to supervise the use of the funds.
ex.zh: 成立了一个特别委员会来监督资金的使用。

ex.en: New drivers must work under the supervision of an experienced colleague.
ex.zh: 新司机必须在有经验的同事监督下工作。

ex.en: Children should not be left in the pool without adult supervision.
ex.zh: 不应让儿童在无人看管的情况下待在泳池里。

ex.en: The project was completed under the close supervision of the safety board.
ex.zh: 该项目是在安全委员会的严格监督下完成的。

supplement.usage: complement补足所缺部分使成完整整体;supplement对已相对完整完善的事物再加补充使其更完善丰富；n.补充物，增补物；增刊 v.增加，增补；索引p417

ex.en: Online education can supplement the traditional kind. It could make extra training and instruction affordable.
ex.zh: 在线教育可以辅助传统教育,它能使人们支付得起额外的培训和指导费用。

ex.en: She takes vitamin supplements in winter to stay healthy.
ex.zh: 她在冬天服用维生素补充剂以保持健康。

ex.en: Many farmers supplement their income by selling crafts to tourists.
ex.zh: 许多农民靠向游客出售手工艺品来补贴收入。

senses: vt. 供应,供给,满足(愿望),补足

phrases.p: supply the articles without monetary reward

supply.usage: 串词记忆：supper(晚饭)supply(供应)哪些食物；索引p417

ex.en: The new pipeline will supply gas to millions of households.
ex.zh: 新管道将向数百万家庭供应天然气。

ex.en: Cutting down trees faster than they grow reduces the supply of timber.
ex.zh: 砍伐树木的速度超过其生长速度，就会减少木材供应。

ex.en: Supplies of food and water were sent to the flooded areas at once.
ex.zh: 食品和水的补给品立即被送往洪涝地区。

support.usage: [族] supportive a. 给予帮助的；支持的；[近] assist vt.&vi. 帮助；援助；词根记忆：sup(under,从下方)+port(carry,搬运)→搬到下方支撑着→支撑

ex.en: Most employees support the plan for flexible working hours.
ex.zh: 大多数员工支持弹性工作制方案。

ex.en: The bridge is supported by eight stone pillars.
ex.zh: 这座桥由八根石柱支撑。

ex.en: Without public support, the reform is unlikely to succeed.
ex.zh: 没有公众的支持，改革不太可能成功。

senses: vt. 假定,认为;(用于祈使句)让,使
suppose.usage: assume 的近义词；同义presume,assume；词根记忆：sup(under,下)+pos(put,放)+e→放下顾虑，大胆去想→假设；②认为(2017)；索引p417

ex.en: In contrast, suppose you give a reasonable argument: that full-time workers should not have to live in poverty.
ex.zh: 相反，假设你给出了一个合理的论点：全职工作者不应该必须生活在贫困中。

ex.en: Suppose the train is delayed; what will you do then?
ex.zh: 假如火车晚点了，你该怎么办？

ex.en: Scientists suppose that the climate was once much warmer here.
ex.zh: 科学家推测这里的气候曾经要温暖得多。

phrases.m: n. 压制,镇压;抑制,阻止

suppress.usage: restrain 的近义词；同义①crush,repress③limit,restrict,refrain;反义express v.表达,表露；v.镇压，压制；封锁，隐瞒；抑 制；sup(往下)+press(压)→压下去→忍住；词根记忆：sup(sub, 在…之下)+press(按压)→在按压之下→镇压；索引p417

ex.en: He could hardly suppress his surprise.
ex.zh: 他几乎抑制不住自己的惊奇。

ex.en: The author is concerned that "moral licensing" may suppress our desire for success.
ex.zh: 作者担心"道德许可"可能会抑制我们对成功的渴望。

ex.en: Officials were accused of suppressing evidence that contradicted the official account of the disaster.
ex.zh: 官员们被指隐瞒与官方对灾难的说法相矛盾的证据。

senses: a. 最高的；至高无上的
adj. 最高的，至高无上的；最大的
adj. （级别或地位）最高的；（程度）很大的
supreme.usage: 同义①highest,greatest③utmost,extreme；adj.至高无上的，最好的 'məʊmənt/ 16 n.瞬间，片刻；某个时刻， 时机；the Supreme Court 最高法院；索引p417

ex.en: It is an event in which she reigns supreme.
ex.zh: 这个比赛项目她所向无敌。

ex.en: For a professional athlete, an Olympic gold medal is the supreme achievement of a career.
ex.zh: 对职业运动员而言，奥运金牌是职业生涯中的最高成就。

ex.en: The supreme court is expected to rule on the case before the end of the year.
ex.zh: 最高法院预计将在年底前就此案作出裁决。

senses: adj. 肯定的，确信的；一定会
sure.usage: 另:be sure to do sth.一定会做某事/for sure肯定地；索引p417

ex.en: I am not sure whether the museum opens on Mondays.
ex.zh: 我不确定博物馆周一是否开放。

ex.en: Make sure that all the windows are locked before you leave.
ex.zh: 离开前务必确认所有窗户都已锁好。

ex.en: She is sure of her facts and rarely makes mistakes.
ex.zh: 她对掌握的事实很有把握，很少出错。

phrases.m: 对待或处理问题不深入彻底

surface.usage: n.表面；水面，地面；外表 v.浮出水面；暴露；出现

ex.en: The table has a smooth marble surface.
ex.zh: 这张桌子有光滑的大理石台面。

ex.en: Rumors about the merger soon surfaced in the financial press.
ex.zh: 有关合并的传闻很快在财经媒体上浮出水面。

ex.en: On the surface, the two proposals look almost identical.
ex.zh: 表面上看来，这两项提案几乎一模一样。

surge.usage: 近义：soar vi. 猛增；索引p417

ex.en: The railroad industry as a whole, despite its brightening fortunes, still does not earn enough to cover the cost of the capital it must invest to keep up with its surging traffic.
ex.zh: 就整个铁路行业来说，尽管前景大好，但它的收入目前依然不足以支付为满足激增的运输需要而投入的资金。

ex.en: There was a surge in demand for masks at the beginning of the outbreak.
ex.zh: 疫情暴发初期，口罩需求激增。

ex.en: Hope surged in her heart when she heard the good news.
ex.zh: 听到这个好消息，她心中涌起一阵希望。

ex.en: I knew that I owed the surgeon my life.
ex.zh: 我明白外科医生救了我的命。

ex.en: The surgeon explained the risks of the operation to the patient's family.
ex.zh: 外科医生向病人家属说明了手术的风险。

ex.en: A skilled surgeon performed the eight-hour operation.
ex.zh: 一位技术精湛的外科医生做了这台长达八小时的手术。

surgery.usage: n.外科手术；诊所；应诊时间

ex.en: He will require surgery on his left knee.
ex.zh: 他的左膝需要做手术。

ex.en: Thanks to modern surgery, most patients recover within a few weeks.
ex.zh: 多亏现代外科手术，大多数病人几周内就能康复。

ex.en: She is recovering well after having surgery last Friday.
ex.zh: 上周五手术后，她恢复得很好。

senses: adj. 外科的,外科医生的
adj. 外科的；外科手术的

ex.en: Please write your surname first, followed by your first name.
ex.zh: 请先写姓，再写名。

ex.en: Smith is one of the most common surnames in England.
ex.zh: 史密斯是英格兰最常见的姓氏之一。

ex.en: After marriage she kept her own surname, which is increasingly common today.
ex.zh: 婚后她保留了自己的姓氏，这在如今越来越常见。

senses: vt. 超过,优于,强于,胜过
surpass.usage: sur（超过）+pass（通过）→通过并超过→超越。近义：exceed vt. 超过；同义exceed,overtake,excel,go beyond；v.超过，胜过；词根记忆: sur(over, 超过)+pass(大步)→超过；索引p417

ex.en: The art market surpassed many other industries in momentum.
ex.zh: 艺术品市场在势头上超过了许多其他行业。

ex.en: The new bridge surpasses all others in the country in length.
ex.zh: 这座新桥的长度超过了国内所有其他桥梁。

ex.en: His latest film surpasses anything he has made before.
ex.zh: 他的最新电影超越了他以前的任何作品。

senses: n. 过剩,剩余,盈余;顺差
surplus.usage: sur（超过）+plus（加）→多加出来的→剩余。反义：deficit n. 赤字；不足；反义deficiency n.缺乏,不足;典型考题foreign trade__again选C.surplus(trade surplus贸易顺差固定搭配;superfluity剩余额;excess过量;redundancy多余)

ex.en: If you have surplus vegetables you'll do a vegetable soup.
ex.zh: 如果你有多余的蔬菜，你可以做蔬菜汤。

ex.en: The country recorded a trade surplus last year, exporting far more than it imported.
ex.zh: 该国去年录得贸易顺差，出口远超进口。

ex.en: Surplus grain can be stored for lean years or sold to neighbouring countries at a profit.
ex.zh: 多余的粮食可以储存起来以备歉收年份，或加价卖给邻国。

senses: v. 使诧异,使惊异;突然而出人意料地攻击

phrases.m: 听任(某习惯、感情、影响等)摆布

ex.en: The rebel army surrendered after weeks of heavy fighting.
ex.zh: 经过数周激战，叛军投降了。

ex.en: He refused to surrender his passport to the police.
ex.zh: 他拒绝向警方交出护照。

ex.en: She finally surrendered to the temptation to check her phone.
ex.zh: 她最终还是没能抵制住诱惑，看了手机。

senses: vt. 环绕；包围；与…紧密联系
surround.usage: sur(在…下面)+round(圆圈)→在下面围一圈→包围；索引p417

ex.en: If you are surrounded by problems and cannot stop thinking about the past, try to focus on the present moment.
ex.zh: 如果你被问题包围且无法停止回想过去，那就努力专注于当下吧。

ex.en: These kids are going to be surrounded by computers—in their pockets, in their offices, in their homes—for the rest of their lives.
ex.zh: 这些孩子将在到处是计算机的环境中——在他们的口袋里，在他们的办公室里，在他们的家里——度过余生。

ex.en: Rumours surround the star's sudden retirement, but her agent refuses to comment.
ex.zh: 这位明星突然退休的传闻四起，但她的经纪人拒绝置评。

ex.en: His paintings try to capture the beauty of the surroundings.
ex.zh: 他的画试图捕捉周围环境的美。

ex.en: The hotel is famous for its peaceful surroundings and excellent service.
ex.zh: 这家酒店以宁静的环境和优质的服务而闻名。

ex.en: It took the child a few weeks to adapt to the new surroundings.
ex.zh: 这孩子花了几个星期才适应新环境。

senses: n. (对犯罪嫌疑人等的)监视(u)

ex.en: On June 7 Google pledged not to "design or deploy AI" that would cause "overall harm," or to develop AI-directed weapons or use AI for surveillance that would violate international norms.
ex.zh: 6月7日，谷歌承诺不会"设计或者利用"会造成"全面损害"的人工智能，也不会开发由人工智能控制的武器，或使用人工智能进行违反国际准则的监视。

ex.en: The suspect was kept under constant surveillance by the police.
ex.zh: 警方对这名嫌疑人实施了持续监视。

ex.en: Cameras installed for public surveillance have raised privacy concerns.
ex.zh: 为公共监控安装的摄像头引发了隐私方面的担忧。

senses: vt. 查看；审视；督察；概述
n. 调查；勘测，测量，测绘
v. 调查;对……做民意调查(或进行民意测验)
v. 测量,测绘,勘测;俯视,眺望;纵览
survey.usage: 同义①examine,review③overlook,oversee；sur(上面)+vey(发音似way"路")→在路上进行"调查；勘测"；辨析：survey 常指民意调查或对被调查人意见、观点的调查，也可指勘测；索引p417

ex.en: A recent survey showed 75 percent of those questioned were in favour of the plan.
ex.zh: 最近的一项调查显示，75%的受访者支持该计划。

ex.en: According to the survey, most employees prefer flexible working hours.
ex.zh: 根据这项调查，大多数员工更喜欢弹性工作时间。

ex.en: The team surveyed the damaged bridge carefully before starting repairs.
ex.zh: 动工修理之前，团队仔细勘测了受损的大桥。

senses: n. [C] (建筑物)鉴定人；(土地)测量员，勘测员

ex.en: Everybody needs some sleep for survival.
ex.zh: 每个人都需要睡眠才能生存。

ex.en: In the desert, finding water is a matter of survival, not comfort.
ex.zh: 在沙漠里，找到水关乎生存，而不是舒适。

ex.en: The survival of many small bookshops depends on loyal customers rather than low prices.
ex.zh: 许多小书店的存亡取决于忠诚的顾客，而非低廉的价格。

survive.usage: 同义①remain,continue②outlive,outlast;反义perish v.死亡,毁灭；sur（在……上）+vive（活）→他在战场上活了下来→幸存。；词根记忆：sur(over, 超过)+viv(live, 存在)+e→超长存在→继续存在；索引p417

ex.en: She survived through two world wars.
ex.zh: 她经历了两次世界大战而幸存。

ex.en: To realize how great was the dramatic activity, we must remember further that hosts of plays have been lost, and that probably there is no author of note whose entire work has survived.
ex.zh: 要想了解戏剧艺术的伟大之处，我们必须要进一步知道，大量的戏剧作品已经失传，可能没有哪一位著名作家的全部作品得以保存。

ex.en: Albert Szent-Györgyi would most likely agree that scientific claims will survive challenges.
ex.zh: 阿尔伯特·森特戈伊最有可能会赞同科学主张将经受住挑战这一观点。

senses: adj. 易受影响的,敏感的
adj. 易受影响（或伤害等）的；敏感的；过敏的；好动感情的

phrases.p: be the most susceptible to advertisements

phrases.m: 易受某事物影响或损害

susceptible.usage: 记：sus-（下）+cept（拿）+-ible→拿走底座后模型易倒塌→易受影响的；adj.易受影响的；敏感的；sus（在……下面）+cept（拿）+ible→能从下面被拿住→易受影响；词根记忆：sus(under,在…之下)+cept(take,抓,拿)+ible(形容词后缀)→被病毒轻松拿下的→易患（病）的；索引p4

ex.en: Women are particularly susceptible to developing depression and anxiety disorders in response to stress compared to men.
ex.zh: 和男性相比，女性面对压力时，特别容易患抑郁症和焦虑症。

ex.en: Researchers have come to believe that dreams are susceptible to emotional changes.
ex.zh: 研究人员已经开始相信梦容易受到情绪变化的影响。

ex.en: Young children are especially susceptible to advertising because they cannot yet judge its intent.
ex.zh: 幼儿尤其容易受广告影响，因为他们尚无力判断广告的意图。

senses: n. 嫌疑犯,被怀疑的人

phrases.m: 怀疑某人是……;猜想某人是……

suspect.usage: 同义①doubt,distrust②think,guess,suppose；v.猜想，认为；怀疑……有罪， 认为……有嫌疑 n.嫌疑犯 /ˌʌndə'ɡ rædʒuət/ 10 n.大学本科生 adj.大学本科生的 chemical 物质对我们的影响deserve 使用最新的electronic 设备进行dynam；v

ex.en: He is the prime suspect in the case.
ex.zh: 他就是这个案子的首要嫌疑人。

ex.en: We have to suspect that continuing economic growth promotes the development of education even when governments don't force it.
ex.zh: 我们不得不猜想，即使政府不强制推行教育，经济的持续增长也会促进教育事业的发展。

ex.en: Researchers suspect that the decline in bee populations is linked to a widely used pesticide.
ex.zh: 研究人员怀疑蜜蜂数量的下降与一种广泛使用的杀虫剂有关。

senses: v. 悬挂；暂缓，推迟，暂停
suspend.usage: sus(下)+pend(悬挂)→挂在下面→悬吊，引申为停止→暂停；词根记忆: sus(under, 在下面)+pend(hang, 悬挂)→悬挂在下面→悬挂；索引p417

ex.en: Production has been suspended while safety checks are carried out.
ex.zh: 在进行安全检查期间生产暂停。

ex.en: Seven months and one election day later, a new conservative city council suspended enforcement of the clean air zone, a first step toward its possible termination.
ex.zh: 七个月后的选举日之后，保守党派的一届新的市议会暂停了清洁空气区的施行，这可能是将其废止的第一步。

ex.en: The airline has suspended all flights to the region until further notice.
ex.zh: 在另行通知之前，该航空公司已暂停所有飞往该地区的航班。
